result.summary: The layout is mostly coherent, but several elements are clipped or overlap. The most notable problem is the 'Tokumaru Ramen' restaurant name being cut off mid-word where it collides with the rating block, plus inconsistent favorite-icon styling and hard-clipped text in the horizontal carousel.

issues.description: The restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' is truncated mid-word ('Ramei') where it runs into the star rating '4.8 (500+)' on the right, with no ellipsis — it looks like a text overflow/collision rather than intentional truncation.
issues.suggestion: Make the title a flex item with min-width:0 and text-overflow: ellipsis, and give the rating block a fixed/shrink-0 width so the title truncates cleanly with '…' before touching the rating.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third card's name 'Trattoria Piccol' is hard-clipped by the screen edge with no ellipsis or visible partial-card affordance beyond the raw cut.
issues.suggestion: Ensure carousel item text truncates with ellipsis within the card width, and keep consistent peek/padding so the partial card reads as scrollable content.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons use inconsistent styling: the first card has a white circular background with dark outline, while the second card has a dark/transparent circle with white outline.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button background, border, and icon color across all cards (e.g., translucent dark scrim with white icon).

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card image is abruptly cut off by the bottom navigation bar with no scroll hint or bottom padding, making the content look truncated rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the nav bar height so the last card can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: The notification bell has a red dot indicator with no textual/accessible label, and delivery-time badges rely on small overlay text over busy imagery which may reduce legibility.
issues.suggestion: Add accessible labels (e.g., 'Notifications, 1 unread') and ensure badge chips have an opaque background for adequate contrast.
